reasons.persona_fit: Directly speaks to an owner-operator with a calm, practical tone and no CTA as required, with only a minor slip using 'I'd' instead of the standard 'we'.
reasons.clarity: Very clear progression from problem definition to policy classification and boundary setting, written in plain English.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical diagnostic question and concrete instruction to define policy rules and human review thresholds prior to automation.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly adheres to guidance: avoids inventing customer results, fake metrics, or unverified automated capabilities.
